tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// rje btsun ri khrod ma ser mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so// ༄༅// swa sti/ rje btsun ri khrod lo ma can bsgom par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro ci nus dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags ma ri khrod ma'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ rang skad cig gis 'phags ma ri khrod mar gsal ba'i snying kha'i nang du pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du pam̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo ri khrod ma lo ma can gyi dbu brgyan du bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam par bzhugs pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥpar+ṇa sha wa rī bh+yaḥ oṃ par+ṇa sha wa rī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu sogs brjod/ oṃ swa bhā ba sogs dang*/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i ri bo ljon shing sna tshogs pa'i nags tshal dang*/ me tog sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi shes pa pam̐ yig gser gyi mdog can de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas khyad par du nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad bsal/ slar 'dus pam̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma ri khrod lo ma can sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa ba'i zhal ser zhing 'dzum khro'i tshul can/ g.yas zhal dkar po zhi ba'i nyams can/ g.yon zhal dmar po chags pa'i nyams can/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos thugs kar rdo rje/

gnyis pas dgra s+t+wa 'debs pa'i tshul/ gsum pas mda' gsor zhing 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang po'i sdigs mdzub la rdo rje'i zhabs pas dkris pa/ gnyis pas 'bras bu dang me tog gis spud pa'i shing lo gsar pa'i sbrang g.yab/ gsum pas gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin po che dang me tog sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis spras shing*/ lha rdzas kyi na bza' dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ me tog dang 'bras bu du mas spras pa'i shing lo gsar pa gshibs pa'i smad g.yogs can/ sbrul dkar pos se ral kha byas pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du bcings shing lang tsho dar la babs pa/ sku shin tu mdzes shing grims pa/ cung zad khro ba/ zhabs g.yas pa'i rting pas 'og gi phyogs brten cing pus mo gdan la btsugs pa/ g.yon pa bzhengs stabs su mdzad pa/ rnam par 'gying ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ snying ga'i nang du nyi ma la gnas pa'i pam̐ ser po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun ma ri khrod lo ma can la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sngar bzhin mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i pam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas shri hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar sngags phreng gis g.yas skor du bskor ba'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul nas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis rlob cing*/
bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang nad rims thams cad zhi bar gyur/ oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa sha wa rī sarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma nā ya swā hā/

sngags 'di ngo bo gcig kyang*/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsar du sarba mā ra dang*/ snar thang brgya rtsar sarba ro ga zhes spel tshig 'dra min tsam snang ngo*// zhes ci nus bzla/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ri khrod lha mo 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang sogs brjod do// ༈ /rjes gnang ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ stegs bu ji ltar rigs pa'i khar maṇ+ḍal lar tshom bu gcig bkod pa'i phyogs mtshams su chu gnyis nyer spyod gtor ma dang bcas pa bsham/ slob dpon gyi mdun du ting shag me tog sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len bzhin sta gon bya'o// slob dpon gyis mchod pa byin brlab/ skyabs 'gro sogs bdag bskyed gong ltar bya/ mdun bskyed bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i sogs nas dbur brgyan/ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas mchod/ bstod pa/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi// cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa las byung ba'i// lha mo gang gis bsgrubs pa'i nad gdon bgegs// kun tu zhi mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo// gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas phul/ mchod bstod bzlas pa rnams grub nas/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu tshar nas/ slob dpon gyis sems bskyed rjes gnang gi mtshams sbyor rgyas pa thar rtse paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'ang yod/ gsal btab/ 'dir pad+ma'i rigs kyi nang tshan las kyi rigs kyi khro bo khro mo'i rgyud yin/ de la'ang du ma zhig yod pa'i nang nas 'dir par+ṇa sha wa rī'i mdo dang*/ ri khrod lo ma gyon ma can zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi rjes su 'brangs te/ paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rjes bkral ba'i 'phags ma ri khrod lo ma gyon ma ser mo zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams grub nas/

khyod rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma'i bya ba la/ slob dpon la rje btsun ma dngos yin snyam pa'i sgo nas rjes su gnang ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab/ rgyun bshags/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab/ dngos gzhi la gzhi dgod pa/ rjes gnang dngos la lung gsum gyi chings sbyar/ rjes kyi chos gsum/ rjes mchog sogs sgrub thabs brgya rtsa ltar bya'o// thar rtse paṇa chen gyis mdzad// ༈ /rje btsun ri khrod ma'i cho ga cha lag dang bcas pa sdig sgrib nad gdon zhi ba'i byin rlabs chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwā sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ ri khrod gnas su ri khrod ma'i// rnam par 'phrul pa'i skur sprul nas// 'gro ba'i rims sogs sel mdzad ma// ri khrod lo ma can la 'dud// ri khrod dpal mo mnyes byas pas// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi// dngos grub ma lus thob bya'i phyir// de yi man ngag rim pa bshad// de la 'di'am gzhan gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'am/ yang na smon 'jug gi sems bskyed thob pa zhig gis 'di'i rjes gnang dang lung sogs bzhugs pa'i bla ma dam pa las rjes gnang nod tshul ni/ dben pa'i gnas su gzhi bzang po'i khar mañdzi'i steng du maṇ+ḍal dri thig tshom bu gcig phyogs mtshams su chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang mdun du gtor ma/ slob dpon la ting shag me tog slob ma la maṇ+ḍal nas bcas rnams bshams nas mchod pa byin rlabs dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin bya/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i bdag bskyed sgom bzlas byas la maṇ+ḍal yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ mchod bstod gtor ma phul/ yang mchod bstod 'dod gsol/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa rnams byas/ slob ma la paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i mtshams sbyor sogs rgyas bsdus ci rigs sngon du 'gro bas dngos gzhi lung gsum gyi

rjes su bzlas pa dam bca' ba byin gyis brlab pa'i lung rnams so// chings sogs brgya rtsa bzhin la/ lha sngags bsgyur/ rjes dam tshig gis bsdus te khas blang ba/ gtso bos sogs/ maṇ+ḍal/ yon 'bul/ deng nas sogs/ chos bsngo/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs/ mdun bskyed la mchod bstod/ bzod gsol dang*/ yig brgya dang ma 'byor pa sogs/ gshegs bsdu/ oṃ khyed kyis sogs/ bsngo ba bkra shis rnams bya'o// de ltar thob pa'i gang zag gis dben pa'i gnas su gtsang sbra dang rdor dkar la gnas pas stegs kyi khar mchod gtor bsham/ bsnyen pa bya tshul ni/ bya rgyud spyi bsnyen bya tshul rmor chen gyi bsnyen thabs sogs las 'byung zhing*/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsams te bdag bskyed sgom bzlas byas la/ rtsa sngags/ tad+ya thā a mṛ ta sogs/ 'bum phrag gcig snying po 'bum phrag nyi shu/ oṃ pi shā tsi sogs/ yang snying 'bum phrag hrīḥha yod pa'i pi shā tsi/ bco lnga bya/ thun mtshams rnams su mdun gyi nam mkhar ri khrod ma spyan drangs la snying po'i mthar spyi ltar a kā ro btags pas gtor ma phul/ mchod bstod sogs rjes gnang bzhin bya ba ni bsnyen pa dang*/ sbyin sreg ni zhi ba'i thab khung bcas la/ lha sngags bsgyur ba ma gtogs dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i mi 'khrugs pa'i sbyin sreg sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin dang*/ sngags kyi kha skong ni snying po bsnyen pa'i bcu cha bzlas pas don 'grub bo// bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i gang zag gis 'gro ba'i rims nad bcad pa'i tshul la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ sa phyogs dben zhing nyams dga' bar ba byung dang*/ ba chu lci ba 'o ma mar zho lnga/ dri bzang gis byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal la tshon dkar po'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus dang 'dab ma brgyad la me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa'am/

yang na rdul tshon dkar po'i tshom bu bkod/ dbus su bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dar ram ras dkar po'i mgul chings prog lnga'am bdun dang ldan pa bcing*/ 'bras bu can kham sta li sogs 'bras bu bzang po 'byung ba'i/ gyi shing rtse mo ma nyams pas kha brgyan/ rin po che lnga/ gser g.yu byu ru mu tig mu men/ sman lnga/ sle tres kaṇ+ṭa ka rī shu dag dkar po rgya mtsho lbu ba dbang lag dri lnga/ tsan+dan dkar dmar gur gum ga pur dzā ti/ snying po lnga/ tshwa bu ram 'o ma mar sbrang*/ 'bras bu lnga/ nas gro sran ma 'bras til/ bcas bkang ba'i steng du rin po che'i sder ma gser dngul shel sogs/ 'bras bus gang ba'i nang du de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel dang*/ 'di nyid kyi gzungs bzhugs shing rab gnas dang ldan pa'i rnam rgyal mchod rten lta bu bzhugs su bcug de'i steng du gdugs dkar po phub/ phyogs bzhir me tog tsam pa ka sogs lag khru gang tsam/ dkar po'i phreng ba gdags/ bre'am tog la gzungs thag 'byor na rin po che dang me tog gi phreng ba'am/ de min gos ras gang rung gi skud pa lnga bsgril las srog chags kyi bal tshon gyis mi rung*/ kyang bcing*/ shing shun la sogs par rtsa sngags sam/ snying po'i mjug tu sarba dz+wa ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥ zhes pa tshar lnga gi waṃ gis bris dbu nas bsgril gos ser gyi thum bcas kha rgyan la gdags/ pa bum pa'i khar bzhag 'khor yug tu chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ gzhan yang mchod rdzas rnams kyis bskor/ sman dang bum rdzas las bshad pa'i sman lnga sogs bzang gras las mi rung*/ dkar gsum/ zho 'o ma mar/ mngar gsum gyis bu ram sbrang rtsi ltar/ brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang*/ dmar gtor dang*/ yang dkar gtor gsum dang dmar gtor dang*/ yang dkar gtor dmar gtor gnyis dang*/ gang 'os pa'i gtor ma gcig dang dgu bsham/

dmar gtor gyi rigs rnams sha khrag dang smug rtsi sogs kyis brgyan/ gzhan yang ras sam dar dkar po khru gang gru bzhi la ba byung lngas ras 'dul byas la/ ri mo mkhan gyis lha mo mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas na zhags pa dang dgra s+t+wa/ g.yon na rma bya'i mjug sgro 'phyar ba dang*/ khu tshur dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub bsgrengs pa/ shing lo gsar pa me tog dang 'bras bur bcas pa'i na bzas bklubs shing rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la zhabs g.yas pa'i rting pas 'og sgo brten pa'i pus mo gdan la btsugs pa/ bzhengs stabs su mdzad pa bris la/ spyan dbye la don gsal sogs nas gsungs pa'i rab gnas spyi 'gre/ sogs pa rab gnas byas te nad thams cad zhi bar mdzad pa'i mnga' bdag tu bsams la/ mchod pa rgya chen pos mchod cing bstod nas/ de dag gi spyan sngar rang nyid grogs dang bcas pa khrus byas/ gos gtsang ma gyon te/ gso sbyong gi thog mar phyag 'tshal ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// zhes pa la sogs pa'i phyag 'tshal rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'os pa dang*/ ji snyed su dag na bza' dam pa nas phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi'i bar rol mo 'bud dkrol tsog pur 'dug nas 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs 'phros rnams bya'o// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// zhes pa nas/ thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir bsngo'o// zhes sogs kyis yan lag bdun pa phul/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs te phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas tshe thog ma med pa nas tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang gti mug gi dbang gis lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba bcu bgyis pa dang*/

mtshams med pa lnga bgyis pa dang*/ de dang nye ba lnga bgyis pa dang*/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba bgyis pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang 'gal ba bgyis pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba bgyis pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la ma gus pa bgyis pa dang*/ pha dang ma la ma gus pa bgyis pa dang*/ mkhan po dang slob dpon la ma gus pa bgyis pa dang*/ grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la ma gus pa bgyis pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos spangs pa dang*/ gsung rab kyi glud zos pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la skur ba btab pa la sogs pa mdor na mtho ris dang thar pa'i gegs su gyur cing 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyur gyur pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa dang ltung ba'i tshogs ci bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ gzhan gyis bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba bgyis pa de dag thams cad bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so// mi 'chab bo// mi sbad do// slan chad kyang bsdam par bgyid lags so// lan gsum gyis sdig pa bshags/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rta cang shes lta bu/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas shing*/ byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ rang gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid pa kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i bka'/ legs pa rnam par grol ba'i thugs/ legs pa rnam par grol ba'i shes rab can de dag gis sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang*/ phan par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang*/ nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang*/

bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir du gso sbyong nges par blangs pa de bzhin du/ bdag gis kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du/ gso sbyong nges par yang dag par blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum bya'o// deng nas srog gcod mi bya zhing*// gzhan gyi nor yang blang mi bya// 'khrig pa'i chos kyang mi spyad cing*// rdzun gyi tshig kyang mi smra'o// skyon ni mang po nyer bsten pa'i// chang ni yongs su spang bar bya// khri stan che mtho mi bya zhing*// de bzhin dus ma yin pa'i zas// dri dang phreng ba dang ni rgyan// gar dang glu sogs spang bar bya// ji ltar dgra bcom rtag tu ni// srog gcod la sogs mi byed ltar// de bzhin du ni bdag gis kyang*// deng nas srog gcod la sogs spang*// sdug bsngal mang 'khrugs sems can rnams// srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /lan gsum bya'o// oṃ a mo gha shī la sam+bha ra sam+bha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ ma hā shud+dha satwa pad+ma bi bhū ṣi ta bhu dza dha ra dha ra sa man+ta a wa lo ki te hūm̐ phaṭa/ nyi shu rtsa gcig bzla/ khrims kyis tshul khrims skyon med cing*// tshul khrims rnam par dag dang ldan// rlom sems med pa'i tshul khrims kyis// tshul khrims pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /de dag ni sbyor ba'i cho ga'o// dngos gzhi la gzungs kyi sgrub pa dang*/ zhar las byung ba khrus kyi cho ga'o// dang po la bdag bskyed sgom bzlas dang*/ bum pa'i cho ga dang*/ sbyin sreg dang*/ gtor ma btang ba'o// dang po ni sngon 'gro gtor ma/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ rdo rje 'thor g.yab dang bcas dri bzang gi chu 'thor/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ rdo rje bsdams pa 'debs pa'i tshul byas la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā d+ya nu pān+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum brjod/ ci 'dod pa'i yo byad thams cad thogs pa med par bsam zhing*/

rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas lha klu gnod sbyin 'byung po'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pa rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas spyan drangs par bsam/ tshig re re'i mjug tu lag pa g.yas pas rdo rje g.yab/ g.yon dril bu gsil zhing*/ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul// nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzang lus srul po// dri za srin po gdon gyi tshogs rnams dang*// gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can// bu smad bcas shing g.yog 'khor bcas pa la// bdag gis pus mo sa la btsugs nas ni// thal mo sbyar nas khyed la gsol 'debs kyis// gsan nas phan gdags slad du 'dir gshegs shig /oṃ sarba lo ka pā la e h+ye his spyan drang*/ pad+ma'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul/ mchod pa so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ de wa/ nā ga yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa ghan+dharba/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ kiṃ na ra/ ma ho rā ga ma nu ṣ+ya/ a ma nu ṣ+ya/ sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ/ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul la/ g.yas rdo rje thugs kar dang*/ g.yon dril bu chig rdung bya zhing*/ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang*// dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang*// shar nub ri rab nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang*// ri bo kun na gang dag gnas pa dang*// rin chen gling na lhag par gang gnas dang*// chu bo kun dang chu bo'i mdo rnams dang*// mtsho dang rdzing bu lteng ka chu ngogs dang*// g.ya' chu sil ma can na gang gnas dang*// grong dang phyugs lhas grong khyer stongs pa dang*// khang stongs dag dang lha yi gnas rnams dang*// gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gnas rnams dang*// dka' thub gnas dang glang chen bres rnams dang*// rgyal po'i dkor khang dag na gang gnas dang*// lam srang sum mdo dang ni bzhi mdo dang*// gang dag lam po che dang shing gcig drung*// dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po dang*// seng ge dred dang gcan gzan gnas rnams dang*// 'brog chen 'jigs su rung bar gang gnas dang*// gang dag gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang*// lhun po dur khrod dag na gnas pa rnams// rab tu dges shing mgu bar gyur nas su// phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug par bcas// bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na// 'di dag gsol zhing legs par bzhes nas kyang*// bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// ces pas phrin las bcol zhing*/

chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*// de rgyud de bzhin gshegs pas bstan// rgyu la 'gog pa gang yin pa// dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsungs// sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste// ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin// yid kyi sdom pa legs pa ste// thams cad du ni sdom pa legs// thams cad srung ba'i dge slong dag /sdug bsngal kun las de grol lo// chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa// de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye// zhes pas chos kyi sbyin pa byin la/ rdo rje thugs ka dang dril bu rgyun dkrol bya zhing*/ lha klu gnod sbyin 'byung po'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi chos sgrub pa'i bar chad nyer bar zhi ba dang*/ bsam pa'i don thams cad chos dang ldan pa yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba lo ka pā la gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes dang mtheb srin gyis se gol gtogs shing gats+tsha zhes pas gshegs su gsol la/ gtor ma gtsang sar dor/ rdo rje gsor dril bu drag tu dkrol zhing*/ gzhan yang rol mo'i sgra drag po dang bcas pas/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya/ ma hā daṃ ṣ+ṭot+ka ṭa bhai ra wā ya/ a si mu sa la/ par shu pā sha hastā ya/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī/

kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ bhan+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ gardza gardza/ bi s+pho ṭa ya bi s+pho ṭa ya/ sarba bi gh+nan bi na ya kā nī ma hā ga ṇa pa ti dzī witā/ an+ta ka rā ya swā hā/ mtshams gcod pa ni/ thal mo sbyar la/ rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya par+ṇa sha ba rī nā ma dhā ra ṇī/ bod skad du/ 'phags ma ri khrod lo ma gyon ma zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags ma ri khrod lo ma gyon ma la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mthu chen thob pa la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das ma mi'u thung sha za mo ri khrod lo ma gyon ma dgra s+t+wa dang zhags pa 'dzin ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jigs pa gang dag ci byung ba de dag thams cad dang*/ yams kyi nad gang dang ci yang rung ba dang*/ 'chi byed gang dag ci yang rung ba dang*/ 'chi byed chen po gang dag ci yang rung ba dang*/ gnod pa gang dag ci yang rung ba dang*/ 'khrugs pa gang dag ci yang rung ba dang*/ khong du gnod pa gang dag ci yang rung ba dang*/ gang dag ci byung ba de dag thams cad ni byis pa kho na la 'byung gi mkhas pa la ni ma yin no// bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig dang bden pa'i ngag gis song zhig dengs shig mkhas pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag gis bdag dang sems can thams cad la bsrung bar mdzod cig yongs su bskyab par mdzod cig yongs su bzung bar mdzod cig yongs su bskyang bar mdzod cig zhi ba dang bde legs su mdzod cig chad pa spang bar mdzod cig mtshon cha spang bar mdzod cig ji srid du gzhom pa'i bar du mdzod cig me'i gnod pa spang bar mdzod cig

chu'i gnod pa spang bar mdzod cig byad stems gcad par mdzod cig mtshams bcing bar mdzod cig sa gzhi bcing bar mdzod cig tad+ya thā/ a mṛ te a mṛ te/ a mṛ ta ud bha be/ a mṛ ta sam+bha we/ ā shwa ste/ ā shwa s+t+waṃ ge mā ma ra mā ma ra/ mā sa ra mā sa ra zhi bar mdzod cig nad thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzod/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzod/ gza' dang rgyu skar gyi nyes pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzod/ mche ba'i dug thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzod/ bcom ldan 'das ma ri khrod lo ma can/ tun+na tun+na/ bi tun+na bi tun+na/ tu ṇa tu ṇa/ tu mu le swā hā/ oṃ gau rī/ gan+dha rī/ tsaṇ+ḍā li/ mā taṃ gi puk+kā si swāhā/ oṃ aṃ ku re/ maṃ ku re/ ku ra re/ paṇ+ṇa sha wa rī swā hā/ na maḥsarba sha ba rī ṇāṃ/ mahā sha ba rī ṇāṃ/ bha ga ba ti pi shā tsi/ paṇ+ṇa sha ba rī pi shā tsi swā hā/ oṃ pe shā tsi paṇ+ṇa sha ba rī hrīḥdzaḥhūm̐ phaṭa pi shā tsi swā hā/ 'phags ma ri khrod ma lo ma gyon ma'i gzungs rdzogs so// de nas gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad la dri bzang gi chu dang*/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis mdzes shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du mchod rdzas rnams oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo dang*/ 'phan gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab/
rol mo ji snyed yod pa'i sgra bya zhing*/ dharmā ra ṇi tshar gsum brjod do/

gsum brjod pa'i dang pos rang gis byin gyis brlabs pa las kyang*/ gzi brjid phun sum tshogs par byin gyis brlabs par mos/ gnyis pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon par mos/ gsum pa'i tshe de dag gis byin gyis brlabs par mos/ de nas bla ma dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= dam pa'i chos rnams la= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la= de nas thal mo sbyar zhing*/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gcig sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags ma ri khrod ma lo ma gyon ma'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ rang skad cig gis 'phags ma ri khrod mar gsal ba'i snying ga'i nang du pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du pam̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo ri khrod lo ma can gyi dbu rgyan du bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam par bzhugs pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na ma ཿpar+ṇa sha ba rī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs bachi// lan gsum/

sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i sogs/ oṃ swa bhā ba sogs dang*/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i ri bo ljon shing sna tshogs pa'i nags tshal dang*/ me tog sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi shes pa pam̐ yig gser gyi mdog can de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ khyad par du nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad bsal/ slar 'dus nas pam̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma ri khrod lo ma can sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa ba'i zhal ser zhing 'dzum khro'i tshul can/ g.yas zhal dkar po zhi ba'i nyams can/ g.yon zhal dmar po chags pa'i nyams can/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos thugs kar rdo rje/ gnyis pas dgra s+t+wa 'debs pa'i tshul/ gsum pas mda' gsor zhing 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang po'i sdigs mdzub la rdo rje'i zhags pa dkris pa/ gnyis pas 'bras bu dang me tog gis spud pa'i shing lo gsar pa'i sbrang g.yab/ gsum pas gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin po che dang me tog sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis spras shing*/ lha rdzas kyi na bza' dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ me tog dang 'bras bu du mas spras pa'i shing lo gsar pa gshibs pa'i smad g.yogs can/ sbrul dkar po'i se ral kha byas pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du bcings shing*/ lang tsho dar la babs pa/ sku shin tu mdzes shing grims pa/ cung zad khro ba/ zhabs g.yas pa'i rting pas 'og gi phyogs brten cing*/ pus mo gdan la btsugs pa/ g.yon pa bzhengs stabs su mdzad pa/ rnam par 'gying ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ yang phyag gnyis ma dmar mo sbyin sreg gi dus yin la/ phyag bzhi ma sngon mo ni drag po'i dus yin zhing*/ 'dir ni ser mo gtso che'o// de ltar bsgoms pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/

mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ snying ga'i nang du nyi ma la gnas pa'i pam̐ ser po bsgom par bya'o// de nas pam̐ las sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun ri khrod lo ma gyon ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs pa la/ sngar bzhin mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas rang la gnyis su med par bstim mo// yang pam̐ gyi yi ge de nyid las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs la snga ma ltar mchod nas/ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas de rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag gsang sngags dang phrin las thams cad la dbang bar byas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam mo// de nas lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la rang gi sems gtad la mnyam par bzhag go /gang gi tshe sngags bzla bar 'dod na/ de'i tshe snying ga'i nang gi pam̐ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba'i 'od kyis/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rgyud bskul bas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs shing bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang nad thams cad bsal bar bsams la/ oṃ pi shā tsi paṇ+ṇa sha ba rī sarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma nā ya swā hā/ zhes bya ba ni snying po'o// oṃ pi shā tsi paṇ+ṇa sha ba rī hrīḥha hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

zhes bya ba ni nye ba'i snying po'o// 'di'i rtsa ba'i sngags bzla bar 'dod na gzungs nyid las 'byung ba bzhin bzla bar bya'o// bsnyen pa'i grangs ni rtsa ba'i sngags 'bum phrag gcig snying po 'bum phrag nyi shu/ yang snying 'bum phrag bco lnga las thams cad ji skad bshad pa bzhin 'grub par 'gyur ro// de la rtsa sngags ni/ tad+ya thā/ a mṛ te/ a mṛ te/ a mṛ ta ud+bha we/ a mṛ ta saṃ bha we/ ā shwa ste/ ā shwa stāṃ ge mā ma ra/ mā ma ra/ mā sa ra/ mā sa ra/ tun+na tun+na/ bi tun+na bi tun+na/ tu ṇa tu ṇa/ tu mu le swā hā/ oṃ gau rī/ gan+dha rī/ tsaṇ+ḍa li/ mā taṃ gi puk+kā si swā hā/ oṃ aṃ ku re/ maṃ ku re/ ku ra re/ paṇ+ṇa sha ba rī swā hā/ na maḥsarba sha ba rī ṇāṃ ma hā sha ba rī ṇāṃ bha ga wa tī pi shā tsi paṇ+ṇa sha ba rī pi shā tsi swā hā/ oṃ pi shā tsi paṇ+ṇa sha ba rī hrīḥdzaḥhūm̐ phaṭa pi shā tsi swā hā/ zhes pa'o// de ltar bzlas pa'i rjes su/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim/ bdag bskyed do// bum pa'i cho ga ni/ de nas ku shas dri bzang gi chu bum pa dang mchod rdzas rnams la gtor zhing*/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas ma dag pa bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā swa bhā ba shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas thams cad stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du mchod rdzas rnams oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon zhes pa nas/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes pa'i bar gnas yo byin rlabs kyi skabs bzhin la/ ngo bo bzang shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/

so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlab/ dri chu dang*/ a mṛ tas bum pa bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyangs pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i bum pa'i steng du pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ yig dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rin po che'i mchod rten/ rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad+ma/ de'i steng du khri zlum po bang rim gsum pa/ de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du bum pa zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba sgo dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du bre/ de'i steng du gdugs rim pa bcu gsum char khebs tog dang bcas pa/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ dar gyi lda ldis mdzes par byas pa'i mchod rten gyi bum pa'i nang du pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du pam̐ yig gser gyi mdog can de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ zhes sogs lha mo bdag bskyed bzhin bsgom/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas ri khrod lo ma can la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba spyan drangs/ spos dang bcas shing rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje rnam sbyangs shing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i// khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yong bdag 'khor dang bcas rnams gshegs su gsol// chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso// btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing*// nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che// dad pas spyan ni drang bar bgyi// zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa// dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs// chos dang ye shes chags bral ba// kun tu mi zad nus par ldan// tshur spyon tshur spyon zhi bdag lha// thub pa'i skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen// shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni// mchod pas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol// 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu// 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang*// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol// oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka ār+ya pi shā tsi paṇ+ṇa sha ba rī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes pas spyan drang*/ ye shes sems dpa'i phyi bzhin du 'brangs nas bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig ces rdor dril gsor dkrol/ na mo badz+ra kro dha sogs sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin gyis phyir 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod// bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das// tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol// bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// pad kor sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ga ga na sa ma ya hūm̐ swā hā/ mchod yon dbul/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gi sku khrus gsol// g.yas pas khrus gsol ba'i stangs ka byed cing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// pad+ma'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas gdan phul la/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gros mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ dbang lha spyan 'dren nas dbur brgyan gyi bar bdag bskyed bzhin bya/ de'i phyi rol gyi steng gi nam mkha' la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa dang*/ 'khor yug tu chos skyong srung ma dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyis bskor bar gyur/ de dag rnams la gong du bstan pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis rim pa bzhin du mchod par bsam zhing*/ so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/

'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus pas bshams pa 'di// ri khrod lo ma gyon ma dang*// rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi// nad gdon bgegs rnams zhi ba dang*// dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta paṇ+ṇa sha ba rī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes mchod yon dbul/ de bzhin du mchod yon gyi gnas su zhabs bsil dang*/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su pā d+yaṃ gis zhabs bsil/ me tog dang*/ puṣ+pe/ bdug spos dang*/ dhū pe/ mar me dang*/ dī paṃ/ dri mchog dang*/ gan+dhe/ zhal zas dang*/ nai wi d+ya/ sil snyan dang*/ shab+da/ zhes pa rnams kyis mchod nas rol mo dbul/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi// cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa las byung ba'i// lha mo gang gis sgrub pa'i nad gdon bgegs// kun tu zhi mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhing dang yul rnams kun tu rnam 'phrul zhing*// khyad par ri khrod gnas su rnam rol nas// sgrub pa po la dngos grub kun stsol ba'i// ri khrod dbang phyug ma la phyag 'tshal lo// sna tshogs zhal dang phyag zhabs sna tshogs dang*// sna tshogs mdog dang cha lugs sna tshogs dang*// sna tshogs rgyan dang phyag mtshan sna tshogs kyis// rnam par sgeg ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod kyis gang gis 'dul ba'i thabs mkhyen nas// me tog 'bras bu du mas rnam spud cing*// shing lo gsar pa'i na bzas rab bklubs pa'i// lo ma gyon ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gsung gi rig sngags zhi ba'i nga ro yis// 'gro ba'i rims dang sdug bsngal zhi mdzad cing*// drag po'i gsang sngags 'brug ltar cher bsgrags pas// gdug pa 'joms mdzad gsung la phyag 'tshal lo// nyid thugs zhi bas 'gro ba zhi mdzad cing*// brtse bas rjes chags dges pa chen po yis// tshe dang dpal 'byor rnam par rgyas mdzad ma// rnam grol yangs pa'i thugs mnga' khyod la 'dud// bsgrub dang bzlas brjod brtson pas khyod kyi thugs// bskul bas bdag la brtse bas nyer dgongs te// nad dang bgegs kyi tshogs rnams zhi ba dang*// tshe dang dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzad du gsol// skye ba kun tu bdag gi mgon mdzad de// nyam nga'i 'jigs pa kun las skyob pa dang*// srid zhi'i bde dga' rgya mtshos rab 'byor zhing*// rdzogs sangs yon tan rgya mtshor 'gyur bar mdzod// ces bstod cing gsol ba gdab/

gzhan yang ji ltar 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo// de nas sgrub pa'i grogs dang bcas pas gzungs thag bzung la/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros/ gzungs thag la brten nas song bas/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs rgyud bskul nas sku'i cha las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa babs pas bum pa'i nang gang ba dang*/ 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros pas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rims nad dang*/ bgegs dang 'byung po thams cad kyi gnod pa zhi bar bsam zhing*/ 'di'i snying po'i sngags gtso bor bzla/ rtsa sngags dang nye ba'i snying po ci rigs bzla'o// thun gyi mthar gong bzhin mchod pa kha gsos byin gyis brlabs nas/ mchod cing bstod la nad zhi bar gsol ba gdab bo// bum pa'i cho ga'o// sbyin sreg ni/ sa stegs sam/ zhal ba'am snod khru sgo ra la sogs ji ltar rigs par zhi ba'i thab khung zlum por kha khyer ram mu ran zlum po stegs bu gru bzhi chag bcas pa'i mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng ba/ stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje/ thab nang pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su tshom bu dmar po nas 'bras gang rung gis bkod/ de'i drung du chu gnyis nyer spyod sbreng tshar du bsham/ snod ji ltar rigs par mi skra mi rus shing nim pa'i lo ma rtsa dūrba mar rnams lhan cig tu bzhag thab khung dri chu dang*/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i nang du pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du pam̐ yig dmar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can gyi don byas/ khyad par du nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad bsal/ slar 'dus nas pam̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/

bcom ldan 'das ma ri khrod lo ma can du gyur pa ni/ sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pa rdo rje dang bcas pa'i khu tshur gyis bgegs kyi tshogs la snun par mdzad cing*/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pas gnod par byed pa thams cad kun tu gzir bar byed pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing*/ khro gnyer bsdus pa mche ba rnam par gtsigs shing lto ba 'phyang ba/ sku thung zhing brjid la sbom pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu 'bar ba/ rus pa dang rin po che dang sbrul gdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ gnas gsum byin rlabs nas/ sa mā dzaḥ'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin dang*/ ma lus sems can nas/ rigs bdag rgyas 'debs kyi bar rgyas 'debs bzhin la/ 'od dpag med kyi dbur brgyan zhes brjod/ spyan 'dren gyi tshe mdun bskyed kyi bum pa'i drung du me tog spos snod spos rengs dang bcas pa bzhag la las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum phul nas kha ras lag lcib dang bcas blangs la spyan 'dren dang bstun slob dpon la phul/ slob dpon gyis spos kyi rtse cung zad btogs/ 'bru phran bu dang bcas pa thab nang du gtor/ bying nye 'khor gyi stegs khar bzhag mchod pa bsang sbyang byin rlabs nas bstod pa rdzogs pa'i bar gong bzhin bya/

mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i mchod bstod sh+lo ka gcig de nas me skra sogs gong gi rdzas rnams brgya rtsa brgyad snying po phul ba'i mthar/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib/ des bskyed pa'i bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad dang*/ khyad par du'ang dus min gyi rims nad gdon bgegs ma rungs pa'i gdug rtsub cho 'phrul ngan pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod pa dang*/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i mchod pa bstod pa gong bzhin/ 'dod gsol kyang spel tshig bzhin la/ cho 'phrul ngan pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes sbyar/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sh+lo ka gcig oṃ khyed kyis sems can gyi mthar/ badz+ra muḥ thab nang gi ye shes pa mchod rten nam bum nang gi lha la thim par gyur/ zhes brjod la spos spar/ las kyi rdo rjes slob dpon la phyag gsum phul nas spos snod bcas blangs la 'bru nas mchod rten dang bum pa la cung zad gtor/ bying sngar shul du bzhag sbyin sreg 'di ma byung yang chad pa'i skyon med/ gtor ma rnams/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri dang ro dang nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bskyed la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes yang yang brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// gtor ma dgu yod pa'i dang po bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du bstabs pas gsol bar bsam zhing rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ pi shā tsi paṇ+ṇa sha ba rī sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba lin gṛh+ṇā pā ya sarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma nā ya swā hā/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis phul la/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi// sogs kyis bstod/

lo ma gyon ma 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// sogs kyis phrin las gzhol/ de bar rol mo 'bud dkrol bya'o// gnyis pa chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul ba ni 'bru gsum lan gsum/ gur zhal sogs la rang rang gi gtor chog bsdus pas phul chog pas gdan sa 'di nyid kyi phyag len ltar na bskyed chog nas phrin bcol rdzogs nang mchod mi dgos/ pa'i bar gtor bsngo sngags sgrub bzhin la gur lcam dral zhal bzhi rnams kyi sngags thung gi mthar/ sangs rgyas bstan srung ma bsdus pa sbyar la bstan srung 'khor dang bcas pa bstod pa'i rjes su/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar/ yang na gtor ma 'di nyid 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la rgyal chen bzhi la 'bul tshul tshe dpag med sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar ro// gsum pa phyogs skyong dang*/ bzhi pa 'byung po la cha gsum bzhin 'bul/ lnga pa 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ bāt+ta li bat+ta li ma hā bat+ta li hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥswā hā/ oṃ klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyas bu// 'jog po dang ni stobs kyi rgyu// pad+ma pad+ma chen po dang*// dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan dang*// lha mo lha mo chen mo dang*// zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che// dbyug 'dzin dbyug 'dzin chen po dang*// sog ma me dang hu lun+ta// dga' bo dang ni nye dga' bo// rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang*// tsha ba tsha ba chen po dang*// dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che// rin chen 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang*// gzugs mdzes chen po sbrul bzang dang*// lto 'phye chen po tshi li dang*// tshi li chen po rnams dag ni// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ ā gats+tsha ya ā gats+tsha ya/ sarba bhur+bhu ba phrum̐ phrum̐ swā hā/

pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ nā ga sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs/ dril bu dkrol/ gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni// sa 'og mun pa mtha' dag sel mdzad cing*// bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab// klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ hi li hi li ma hā hi li phrum̐ phrum̐ swā hā/ oṃ bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha phrum̐ phuḥhūm̐ swā hā/ lan gsum/ dril bu rgyun chags su dkrol la de ltar na/ klu'i rgyal po brgyad kyis gtsor byas pa'i klu gnyan sa bdag gi rigs thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la gnod cing lan chags pa'i klu gnyan sa bdag gi rigs thams cad gtor ma 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtsho chen po 'dis tshims shing mnyes nas gnod pa dang gdug pa'i bsam pa zhi nas phan pa dang zhi ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig nā ga sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha/ mtheb srin gyis se gol phyir gtogs/ ga ru haṃ bya khyung gi phyag rgya/ sa he tsa le tsa le swā hā/ drug pa 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor spyi 'gro bzhin la/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi rjes su/ lha yi tshogs rnams nas/ kun 'grub shog 'di'i rjes su 'og gi gzhi bdag gtor ma yar 'then/ gi bar/ bdun pa 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams kyi nad bdag gdug pa can sha khrag la dga' ba thams cad a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ a kā ros bsngos pa'i mthar/ thal mo sbyar la/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ dril bu rgyun chags su dkrol la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di ni nad bdag rims bdag yams kyi bdag mo la sogs pa gdug pa can gnod byed kyi tshogs ngos ma zin pa sa dang bar snang la gnas nas 'dod pa'i bgegs byed cing mi 'dod pa skyed par byed pa sha khrag srog dbugs la longs spyod pa rnams la sbyin no// bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas thog drangs sems can thams cad la rims nyin gcig pa dang*/

nyin gnyis pa dang*/ nyin gsum pa dang*/ nyin bzhi pa dang*/ nyin bdun pa dang*/ rtag pa'i rims rnams dang*/ rims mi zad pa rnams dang*/ rims ldangs dub pa rnams dang*/ 'byung po'i rims rnams dang*/ rlung las gyur pa rnams dang*/ mkhris pa las gyur pa rnams dang*/ bad kan las gyur pa rnams dang*/ 'dus pa las gyur pa rnams dang*/ rims nad thams cad dang*/ klad pa na ba dang*/ gzhogs phyed na ba dang*/ yi ga 'chus pa dang*/ mig nad dang*/ sna nad dang*/ kha nad dang*/ mgul nad dang*/ snying nad dang*/ lkog ma'i lha gor na ba dang*/ rna ba na ba dang*/ so na ba dang*/ rnyil na ba dang*/ klad pa na ba dang*/ rtsib logs na ba dang*/ rgyab na ba dang*/ lto ba na ba dang*/ rked pa na ba dang*/ chu so na ba dang*/ brla na ba dang*/ rje ngar na ba dang*/ lag pa na ba dang*/ rkang pa na ba dang*/ yan lag na ba dang*/ nying lag na ba dang*/ khyad par du yang 'brum pa dang*/ be ge dang*/ cham pa dang*/ klad gzer dang*/ gag pa dang*/ gzer thung dang*/ gnyan glang dang*/ rgyu gzer dang*/ me dbal dang*/ rman bu dang*/ nywa log dang*/ lhog pa dang*/ 'bras dang*/ 'dzum bu ltag dgye dang*/ mkhris pa rtsar rgyug dang*/ nang lhog dang*/ kha med dang*/ 'khyams po dang*/ 'bar 'bur dang*/ rna rtsa phus 'debs dang*/ ngam rul sogs pa dus min gyi gnyan nad rnams dang*/ mdor na nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi sogs lus ngag yid gsum la gnod par byed pa thams cad til 'bru tsam yang ma gtong zhig bsam ngan gdug rtsub gnod 'tshe'i bsam pa thams cad zhi zhing gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems rin po che rgyud la skyes nas/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas thog drangs sems can thams cad la phan sems dang ldan par gyis shig nad rims yams bdag rnams kyi rgyud la/ byang chub sems mchog rin po che// ma skyes pa rnams skye gyur cig /skyes pa nyams pa med pa yang*// gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung nas/

'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye'i bar/ oṃ chen po nas/ nad de rab tu sol mdzod la// gdon khyod rang gi gnas su dengs// ro ga pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha/ na mo badz+ra sogs drag rol dang bcas pas gtor ma rgyang ring du 'phen/ thal mo sbyar la/ tad+ya thā/ tsa li mi tsa li mi pa na ko ki li shrī ma ti/ kuṇ+ḍa li/ dun+dhu bhi/ in+d+rā ni mu khe swā hā/ 'di dag ni zas ma zhu ba dang*/ sbos pa dang*/ khrag dang mkhris pa 'dres pa dang*/ gzhang 'brum gyis btab pa dang*/ gzhang nad can dang*/ za khu dang*/ lud pa can dang*/ rims nad can dang*/ klad pa na ba dang*/ gzhogs phyed na ba dang*/ yi dwags kyis zin pa'i gsang sngags kyi gzhi yin te/ gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag las/ 'gal bar byed pa de ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na ma mthong ngo*// gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa ste 'di la sangs rgyas ni sems can thams cad kyi mchog go /'dod chags dang bral ba ni chos thams cad kyi mchog go /dge 'dun ni tshogs thams cad kyi mchog go /bden pa'i tshig dang bden pa'i ngag 'dis bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas thog drangs sems can thams cad kyis zos pa dang*/ 'thungs pa dang*/ 'chos pa dang*/ myang ba rnams legs par bde bar zhu bar gyur cig swā hā/ tad+ya thā/ dz+wa la ni/ dz+wa la ni/ pra dz+wa la ni/ pra ti pa ne/ pra sha ma ni/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi rims nad song zhig ma 'dug cig swā hā/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis 'jig rten na sangs rgyas bla na med pa dang*/ chos bla na med pa dang*/ dge 'dun bla na med pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig des bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi rims nad song zhig ma 'dug cig swā hā/

zhes brjod/ brgyad pa 'bru gsum gyi byin brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams kyi nad bdag gdug pa can dkar phyogs la mi dga' ba thams cad ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te sogs kyis sbyin/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ dril bu rgyun chags su dkrol la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po nas/ ma 'dug cig swā hā'i bar gong bzhin/ dgu pa 'bru gsum gyis byin brlab/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wa ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ sngags de nyid la a kā ro btags pas phul/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ dril bu rgyun chags su dkrol la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyis gtsor byas pa'i 'dzam bu gling gi gzhi yi bdag po rnams dang*/ khyad par du'ang bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i brtan ma bcu gnyis/ sgos dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ bye brag tu'ang yul phyogs 'di nyid dang sa phyogs 'di nyid na gnas pa'i lha/ klu/ btsan/ bdud/ rgyal po/ ma mo/ sa bdag gnyan mthu bo che/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag grong bdag dkor bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la 'bul lo// 'jig rten gyi khams su char chu dus su 'bab pa dang*/ lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa dang*/ mi nad dang*/ phyugs nad dang mu ge thams cad rgyun chad cing mi 'byung ba dang*/ dus kyi 'khrugs pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad 'gro na ma chags/ 'dug na ma dogs/ 'gro ba la shol 'debs ma byed/ sdod pa la skul ma ma byed/ gnas mgron gyi dam tshig srung*/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad 'gro 'dug bya ba spyod lam ci byed kyang ru nga ba dang phrag dog par ma mdzad par chos dang mthun pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod cig

chos rnams thams cad sogs nas/ 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye'i bar/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha zhes brjod/ bgegs gtor 'phags pa rin po che'i cho ga na ma gsungs shing*/ gtong na'ang mi 'gal lam snyam/ gtong na 'dir gtong*/ gtor ma'o// de nas mchod rten gyi nang du yod pa'i lha rnams la mchod bstod bsdus pa bya/ sems can gyi nad zhi bar gsol ba btab/ 'gro ba nad pa sogs/ sems can nad pa sogs/ phyogs rnams kun na sogs/ phyogs bcu'i sems can gang rnams sogs/ bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad dang rims kun sogs nas/ dri ma thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol gyi bar dang*/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i gsungs sa skya nad grol ma sogs brjod do/ /bzod par gsol/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs/ gang yang bdag blo sogs/ gtso bo nus pa sogs/ mchod rten la brtan bzhugs dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i rnam rgyal stong mchod kyi mjug nas 'byung ba sogs/ gtor ma'i mgron rnams gshegs su gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs/ dge ba bsngo/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag sogs/ shis pa brjod/ de ltar thun bzhi'i rim pas zhag gsum mam/ bdun nam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du bsgrubs par byas pa'i mthar/ bzod par gsol zhing*/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskangs la dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bya'o// bum pa'i steng na mchod rten yod na gshegs gsol mi dgos shing*/ gal te mchod rten med na bum pa'i nang ngam steng du lha bskyed par bya ste/ mthar ye shes sems dpa' gshegs su gsol nas/ dam tshig pa zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur blta'o// sgrub pa nam byed kyi bar nyin re bzhin 'og nas 'byung ba'i sbyang ba nas shis pa brjod pa'i bar tshar re sgrub khang gi dbus nas bya'o// gzungs kyi sgrub pa bstan zin to// khrus kyi cho ga ni/

bsgrub bya nyung ngu'i don byed na dngos su bkru zhing*/ ku sha la sogs pas spyi bo nas gtor la khrus kyi tshigs bcad dang sngags rim pa bzhin brjod par bya'o// skye bo mang po'am/ grong khyer ram/ rta phyugs mang po'i don byed na/ grong khyer bskor ba'i phyir dung dang rnga dang*/ ba dan la sogs rol mo sna tshogs pas sna drangs te lha mo'i sku dang*/ ri khrod ma sngon mo/ glegs bam dang*/ tog gzungs dang*/ 'di'i gzungs mdo/ gtsug gtor/ gtor ma rnams spyan drangs shing*/ sngags mkhan dang*/ rdor dril gsor dkrol byed cing*/ dge 'dun rnams dang*/ pi shā tsi 'ur 'don bye cing*/ mi dpa' bo go cha gyon cing mtshon cha thogs pa mang po dang bcas pas/ 'dre gdon nad bdag la sdigs par byed cing 'dre gdon skrod pa'i drag sngags dang sgra skad chen po'i khu 'debs mang pos bskor/ mi de dag gi mgo la shing lo la par+ṇa sha wa rī'i snying po gi haṃ gis bris pa btags shing*/ thams cad kyis sngags zlo bzhin pas rang nyid par+ṇa sha ba ri ma'am bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa dang*/ sngags g.yog 'phags pa kun dga' bo dang*/ 'khor rnams sha ba rī 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang phyogs skyong dang 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur pa rnams kyis grong de'i nad gdon skrod cing*/ nad yams zhi ba dang*/ 'jig rten la phan gdags pa'i phyir gshegs so// zhes brda sprad do// kun gyi thugs mthun par dgongs shing grong khyer bskor la/ grong de'i lho phyogs kyi sgo yi phyi rol du/ shin tu gtsang shing mtho ba'i sar me long la de dag gi gzugs brnyan 'char du bcug la/ gtor mas bsgrub bya de dag la bskor zhing*/ oṃ sarba bi gh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swā hā/
zhes pa'i sngags dang bcas pas/ gsum mam bdun gyis de dag la gnod par byed pa

zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba spyi 'gre/ rnams la byin la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ khro bo spyan 'dren bstod pa dang bcas pa'i rjes la/ skye bo 'di dag la gnod par byed pa'i nad bdag bgegs dang 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad tshims par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par song zhig ces brjod la drag po'i sngags dang*/ rol mo'i sgra drag po bya'o// mi'i rus pa/ sha /skra/ sen mo/ shing kun/ sgog skya/ ga pur/ nyungs kar/ gla ba/ sbrul lpags rnams sbyar la/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bdag bskyed kyi gzungs ring rdzogs nas sngags 'di nyer gcig bzlas la rdzas rnams la nyin ltar gyi phus btab/ tud tra ya/ tad+ya thā/ sa ra sa ra/ pra sa ra pra sa ra/ ga ha ga ha/ bi ga bhi bi ga ha/ ti li ti li/ a la thā/ ha si ni/ ga ga ṭa ṭa/ tud tro/ nya pa a hi/ tha tha/ tsu lu tsu lu/ tsu lu ka tha tha/ zhes nyer gcig bzlas pa sreg cing*/ grong khyer thams cad du bdug la/ thams cad kyis 'dre gdon skrod pa'i sngags dang khus gdab par bya'o// de nas nad gdon sdig sgrib rnams til la bstims la/ rab gnas sogs nas 'byung bzhin/ mer bsregs pas sdig pa sbyang*/ de nas grong khyer la sogs pa me long gi nang du shar ba la bum pa'i chus bkru zhing*/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs dang*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la// zhes sogs dang*/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin nas// dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// zhes pa'i bar sngags dang bcas pas khrus bya/ sku phyi ba'ang bya'o// de nas rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa nyan thos dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang*/ phyogs skyong dang 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba byon nas/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi nad dang gdon dang rims dang nye bar 'tshe ba la sogs pa'i 'gal rkyen thams cad sel ba la dgongs pa rtse gcig tu mdzad par bsam zhing*/

'don pa'i grogs dang bcas pas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o// bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba can gyis bka' stsal pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dgongs pa/ rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bsams pa/ dgra bcom pa thams cad kyis bsams pa/ slob pa thams cad kyis bsams pa/ nyan thos thams cad kyis bsams pa/ bden pa'i tshig dang ldan pa thams cad kyis bsams pa/ chos kyis bsams pa/ tshangs pas bsams pa/ tshangs pa so sos bsams pa/ 'dod pa'i dbang phyug gis bsams pa/ dbang pos bsams pa/ lhas bsams pa/ lha ma yin thams cad kyi dbang pos bsams pa/ lha ma yin thams cad kyis bsams pa/ lha ma yin gyi mngag gzhug pas bsams pa/ 'byung po thams cad kyis bsams pa/ bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba can gyis bka' stsal pa/ muñtsa ta/ muñtsa ta/ ma 'dug cig yams kyi nad rnams zhi bar gyur cig rol mo drag po bya/ 'og ma rnams la'ang 'gre/ nirgats+tsha ta/ nirgats+tsha ta/ nirgats+tsha ta/ nirgats+tsha ta/ sangs rgyas lha chen po lha'i yang lha/ lha'i bla ma gshegs shing*/ dbang po bcas pa'i lha rnams dang*/ tshangs pa dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ dbang po dag dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ skye dgu'i bdag po dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi po dag kyang 'ong ngo*// lha 'bum phrag du ma dag dang*/ lha ma yin gyi dbang po rnams dang*/ lha ma yin 'bum phrag du ma dag kyang 'ong ngo*// bcom ldan 'das la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po 'bum phrag dag kyang sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir 'ong ste/ de dag khyed rnams la/ gnod pa chen po byed par 'gyur du 'ong gis/ nirgats+tsha ta/ nirgats+tsha ta/ nirgats+tsha ta/ nirgats+tsha ta/ myur du byer cig khyed cag las gang dag sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa de dag ni phung bar gyur cig gang dag byams pa'i sems dang ldan zhing nye bar 'tshe bar mi 'dod la/

srung bar 'jug par 'dod pa de dag ni 'khod cig lus la yang 'jug par gyis shig sangs rgyas 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba can gyis bka' stsal pa/ su mu/ su mu/ su mu/ su mu/ su mu/ su mu ru/ su mu ru/ su mu ru/ su mu ru/ su mu ru/ su mu ru/ mu ru/ mu ru/ mu ru/ mu ru/ mu ru/ mu ru/ mu ru/ mu ru/ mi ri/ mi ri/ mi ri/ mi ri/ mi ri/ mi ri/ mi ri/ mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru ri ti ri/ ri ri ri ri ri ri ri ri ri/ rī rī tī/ mī rī/ mī rī/ mī rī/ mī rī ti/ ha sa mī ri ti/ mī ri ti/ mī ri ti/ sī mi/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka ro ti ti/ ku ri sho/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rī she/ kaṃ ka rī she/ ri ri ri ri ri ri/ ti ri ti phus/ ri phu/ ri phu/ ri phu/ ri phu/ ri phu/ ri phu/ ri phu/ ri phu/ nā thā/ nā nā tha thā/ nirgats+tsha ta/ ri phu/ ri phu/ nirgats+tsha ta/ pā la yā tha/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba can/ sems can thams cad la phan par lhag par dgongs pa dang ldan pa/ byams pa la gnas pa/ thugs rje dang ldan pa/ dga' ba la gnas pa/ btang snyoms la gnas pa gshegs kyis/ k+ṣi pra nirgats+tsha ta swā hā/ rol mo drag po bya/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi mchog dang*/ chos nyid kyis lha thams cad dang*/ 'byung po thams cad la bka' stsal pa'i gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag grub pa'o// tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag ni grub pa'o// zhes brjod do// de nas sgrub pa'i grogs 'ga' zhig gis dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ yang na mgrin gcig tu bsdebs la skad gsang mthon pos 'di skad ces/

gang la ser sna rnam chags pa// rnam bcom dri ma med mdzad cing*// thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// 'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams// thar pa'i lam du 'dzud mdzad cing*// chos rnams thams cad ston pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// ston pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi rten// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// gang zhig bde ba mnga' mdzad des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yi// thugs kyis 'gro ba'i 'di dag kun// bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// gang zhig 'khor bar 'khor ba yi// sems can kun gyi rten gyur cing*// gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// gang zhig chos rnams mngon sum gyur// gtsang zhing bkru ba mi mnga' la/ gsung gtsang gtsang mar mdzad pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pas// phun sum tshogs don 'byor gyur cing*// don grub tshogs kyang grub pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// gang zhig skyes pas sa rnams ni// nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yos shing*// sems can thams cad rab dga' des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// byang chub snying por gshegs pa na// sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur cing*// bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na// 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsung zhing*// thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed// thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing*// tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad// brgya byin lhar bcas bde legs dang*// 'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni// khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig

/sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang*// lha rnams kyi ni bsams pa yis// khyed kyi 'dod don gang yin pa// don de de ring grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /khyed cag lam 'gro bde legs shog /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing*// khyed cag kun tu bde legs shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /sangs rgyas lha rnams stong dag gis// yongs su bskor te gshegs mdzad kyi// sdang sems ldan pa rnams byer cig /snying rje'i bdag nyid can rnams 'khod// sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas rnams dang*// dgra bcom slob pa'i bden tshig gis// 'jig rten mi phan byed pa rnams// grong khyer 'dir ni stongs gyur cig /sems can kun dang srog chags kun// 'byung po kun dang khyed cag kun// bde ba 'ba' zhig ldan gyur cig /gang yang sdig par ma gyur cig /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur te// sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung*// skye rgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing*// nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod gyur cig bum chog rgyas pa'i yangs pa can gyi grong khyer du 'jug pa'i gzungs 'di 'phags pa rin po che'i bum chog las 'byung ba sor bzhag dang*/ bsdus pa'i skabs gzungs 'dus las byung ba sor bzhag yin pas 'dra min 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan de'o/ /ces brjod du gzhug go /de nas rang gis ku sha la sogs pas bum pa'i de bar slob dpon gyis tshig ci rigs brjod/ chu gtor zhing*/ oṃ pi shā tsi paṇ+ṇa sha ba rī sarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma nā ya che ge mo'i grong khyer pa rnams/ rta'i tshogs sam/ phyugs la sogs pa'i sdig pa dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi/ sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/

nad thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru= gdon thams cad= rims thams cad= gza' dang rgyu skar gyi gnod pa thams cad= rgyal po'i gnod pa thams cad= mi rgod kyi gnod pa thams cad= gcan gzan gyi gnod pa thams cad= byad stems kyi gnod pa thams cad= gzhon nu'i gdon thams cad= phas kyi rgol ba thams cad= bkra mi shis pa thams cad= rmi lam ngan pa thams cad= mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad= ltas ngan pa thams cad= keg sri ngan pa thams cad= mdor na mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā zhes brjod la/ nad kun zhi bar gyur cig la sogs pa'i smon lam gdab bo/ 'dir yang gong bzhin zhi ba'i tshigs bcad rnams bton la/ /bum chu mi phyugs thams cad la gtor bas nad thams cad zhi bar bsam/ de nas lho sgo'i nang nas rkang pa g.yas pas them pa mnan la 'di'i gzungs gling gzhi dang mtshams gcod skabs bzhin/ bcas pa lan gsum bklags te mtshams gcad/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i rig sngags bum steng gi shog dril thum bu gcig bris pa ya them la glan/ rig sngags dang bcas pa'i shing lo gsar pa sgo gong du btsugs pas bsrung ngo*// de bzhin du nub dang*/ byang dang*/ shar du'ang cho ga rnams tshang bar bya'o// rims drag po bcad pa la lho sgo nas shar dang*/ thum bu gcig byang dang*/ thum bu gcig nub tu/ thum bu gcig bskor bas cho ga drag po bya'o// de nas lha mo'i thum bu gcig sngags dang shing lo dang bcas pas grong gi dbus su rgyal mtshan gyi rtse la btsugs la mchod pa rgya chen pos der chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pa sogs rnam grangs mang bar bshams la/ bsang sbyang byin brlab/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho sogs tshigs bcad dang*/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gros mchod/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ 'dod yon lnga spyi 'gre bzhin la/ mos blos rgyal ba sras bcas la 'bul na// zhes sogs phul mthar bstod pa rgyas pa dang*/ nad zhi ba'i tshigs bcad gzungs tshar nyer gcig sogs kyi mthar bkra shis brjod do//

mchod cing bstod nas nad zhi bar gsol ba gdab/ gzungs tshar gsum la sogs pa bzlas pas brtan par bya'o// de ltar thams cad kyis sems can thams cad la phan pa'i bsam pas 'dun pa gcig pas cho ga bya zhing*/ lha mo dus thams cad du mchod cing nad zhi bar gsol ba gdab par bya'o// khrus kyi cho ga bstan zin to// dngos gzhi'i cho ga'o// rjes ni maṇ+ḍal dang mchod pa rnams bsdu/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya/ slob dpon 'khor dang bcas pa dga' ston gyis mnyes par bya zhing bsngo ba dang smon lam rgya cher gdab shis pa brjod par bya'o// rjes kyi cho ga'o// de ltar sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis ri khrod ma'i cho ga bstan zin to// 'jig rten khams 'dir thub pa'i dbang po yis// gdul bya gang la gang gis 'dul ba yi// chos kyi sgron me sna tshogs gsal bar gsungs// khyad par 'gro mang nad kyis gzir ba la// lo ma gyon ma'i cho ga rjes su gnang*// de yi gdams pa byin rlabs chu rgyun 'di// brtse chen ba ri pa las legs brgyud de// rje btsun sa skya pa la bka' babs nas// cho ga'i rnam grangs shin tu gsal bar mdzad// bdag la de bas lhag pa ci byar yod/ /'on kyang /blo dman rnams la 'jug pa bde ba dang*// blo gsal rnams la spro ba skyed pa dang*// 'gro mang nad kyis gzir ba mthong gyur nas// brtse ba'i bsam pas 'di nyid bris pa yin// nyes pa mchis na mkhas rnams bzod par gsol// legs pa'i dge bas nad rnams zhi gyur cig /nad rims gcod pa'i gdams ngag la// 'di las zab pa yod mi srid// 'di 'dra'i cho ga ma mthong zhing*// gdams ngag sad sud re tsam gyis// blun po mgo bo bskor ba yi// bshes gnyen de dag skal ba dman// bka' yod lhad med brgyud par bcas// brjod bde rnam gsal cho ga 'di// mkhas pa 'ga' la ma grags shing*// sa skya pa yi dpal 'byor yin// de ltar ri khrod ma lo ma gyon ma'i sgrub thabs cho ga dang bcas pa 'di ni 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung tshad mar byas te/

dga' ldan pa kun bsod kyi zin ris kyis kha bskangs nas dpal ldan sa skya pa'i phyag len dang mthun par/ rdo rje 'dzin pa byang phug kun dga' legs pas mdzad pa rnams gtso bor bzung*/ kha bskang 'os pa rnams bla ma gong ma'i yig cha so so nas 'di dang mi 'gal ba rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa 'di'ang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ snyigs ma lnga bdo'i nad kyi du ru ka bdo ba'i mgo zug 'dra mo shar ba'i tshe/ bod yul sogs 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad la phan pa'i bla ma gong ma'i gsung gi gsal byed du bkod pa 'dis sems can thams cad nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dang*/ khyad par sman bcos gang gis kyang bzlog tu med pa'i nad ngan mtha' dag dang bral nas 'phral yun bde skyid kho nas 'tsho ba'i rgyur gyur cig /rtsa yig pa ni gzhu lung pa'o// sarba dā maṅga laṃ// ༈ /ri khrod ma'i cho ga'i zur 'debs byin rlabs chu rgyun spel ba'i gangs ri bzhugs so// swa sti/ ri khrod lo ma gyon ma'i cho ga'i khrigs chags kyi rim par/ gtsug lag khang la sogs pa'i gnas su stegs mtho zhing yangs par ras dkar dang stan khebs sogs gzhi gtsang ma dri nog med pa'i steng du nas 'bras gro sogs 'bru dngos gtsang lhad med bkram pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkar po'i steng du mañdzi la bum pa bkod pa'i khar rin po che'i phor pa shing 'bras gtsang mas bkang ba'i dbus su mchod rten gyi bre la gzungs thag btags pa bzhag bum pa'i rgyab tu ri khrod ma sngon mo'i thang sku cod pan can rang la zhal phyogs par bkram/ de'i steng du gdugs me tog gi phreng ba can phub/ mthar chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod g.yas skor mtshams 'dzin dang bcas pa bsham/ de'i mthar spos me zan brgya mchod tsam 'grub kyang mchog tu legs/ de'i mthar bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid sna bdun 'dod yon lnga sogs kyi tsa ka li yod na'ang 'khor mor bkram/

gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs dngos su yod na'ang btsugs pa'i shar du li ma yin pa gser dngul zangs lcags la sogs kyi snod dam/ ye ma 'byor na rdza sder rdo g.yam sogs kyi steng du gtso mo'i gtor ma khru gang tsam zlum po/ pad 'dab bzhis bskor zhing rtse rgyan dang ldem sogs mar rgyan sna tshogs kyis nor bu dang shing 'bras me tog lo ma sogs kyi ri mo mdzes tshon du ma dang*/ sgor rgyan ci mdzes kyis brgyan pa'i mthar sman dang dkar gsum mngar gsum phung por spungs pa la smyug ma gtsang ma'am ku sha la brten pa'i gtor gdugs phub/ de bzhin tu 'og nas 'byung ba'i gtor ma rnams kyang snod so sor che chung mtho gang tsam/ dkar gtor rnams zlum gtor pad+ma'i snying po can pad 'dab bzhis bskor ba dang*/ dmar gtor rnams smad nas rtse'i bar byin gyis phrar song zhing zur rtse mi rno ba la mdun du theb kyu thod gzugs can/ gtor ma de thams cad la rtse dang dkyil du sgor rgyan re/ 'byor na thams cad la gtor gdugs dkar po bcas gzhung bzhin la/ bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis phyir btang na legs pas drug pa dmar gtor gyi rjes su dgu pa dkar gtor bsham zhing*/ phyi rol gtor ma dkar dmar gnyis stegs la bshams la/ chu gtsang bran/ gu gul gyis bdug sbyar spos reng bu phal cher la gla rtsi dang chang 'dres pas bya rgyud la mi rung*/ dpon slob rnams kyi drung du rdor dril/ 'thor nas/ rol sil/ rnga dung sogs dang*/ 'og tu dgos pa'i sbyong chas/ gu gul/ yungs kar/ khrus long*/ sku phyis sogs yo byad gang dgos 'du bya'o// cho ga byed pa'i thog mar yan lag lnga'i khrus bya ba'am/ yang na gdong lag pa tsam bkru/ rab byung yin na chos gos dang snam sbyar gyon/ sgrub khang du zhugs nas rten la kha phyogs par rang gi snying ga nas zhes sogs kyis tshogs zhing spyan drang*/ phung pos lcogs na tshigs bcad thams cad la phyag bya/

ma lcogs na bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar/ thal mo snying gar sbyar te phyag 'tshal lo dang 'dud ces nam byung ba'i tshe lus dang mgo dud tsam re byas la phyag 'tshal gyi tshig mang bas gdangs med par 'dur bshur gang rung gis byas la/ bsngo ba rdzogs nas rang rang gi gral la 'khod sdig bshags dang gso sbyong blang*/ sngon 'gro gtor ma la gdangs dang dril gsil phyag len bzhin byed/ gtor ma phyir dor ba'i tshe rol mo drag dung sogs bgegs gtor la byed pa bzhin bya/ tshogs zhing gi mchod pa la mgor mtshan sngags dang mjug tu pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐ kun la sbyar/ snying po nye snying shub bur ci rigs dang*/ rtsa sngags dang rdzas sngags nyer gcig 'ur 'don byas pa'i rjes su bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can sogs gsol gdab dang gdan bsdu/ mchod pa byin brlab/ bum bskyed bya/ phyir 'brang gi bgegs bskrad la dung dang rol mo rab gnas bzhin mchod pa'i tshigs bcad dang sngags la gdangs phyag rgya bcas/ gzhung du mi gsal ba rgyal srid sna bdun

yo ga ltar 'dod yon lnga rnams phul na/ bcom dril byas la bstod pa gdangs sam 'dur gang rigs/ snying po stong*/ nye snying lnga brgya shub bur/ rtsa sngags phreng 'khor 'ur 'don byas mthar/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang nas stsal du gsol gyi bar bdag bskyed kyi mjug bzhin/ mchod pa byin brlab rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma'am bstod pa gong bzhin byas la sbyin sreg la 'jug rdzas rnams ril bu mthe'u chung gi mgo tsam byas nas phul na dri chung zhing 'gad gtsang*/ gtor ma'i mchod pa'i mthar mchod rol bcas la bstod pa sh+la ka gcig dril bu gsum rdung dang bcas mchod sbyin gtor ma nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi mthar rol mo 'bud dkrol bya/ sbyin sreg dang 'di'i mchod sngags gdangs med pas/ gtor ma 'og ma rnams la gdangs ma byung kyang chog cing*/ rol mo thob mtshams dril gsil bya/ nad bdag dmar dkar gyi gtor ma phyir dor gzhi bdag gtor ma'i rjes su nad bdag dmar dkar gyi gtor ma chod pa bcas dang rdor dril rol mo dung sogs khyer/ zhwa gyon/ grong khyer gyi phyi lam gyi gzhi mdo lta bur phyin la/ gtor ma dmar dkar a mṛ tas bsang ba sogs la gtso gtor byin rlabs bzhin dang*/ cho ga gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin la dkar gtor rgyang ring du dor ba'i bar phyi bya/ de nas nang du log pa'i tshe rol mo'i sgra sogs ci yang mi dgos par log la gral la 'khod nas/ tad+ya thā/ tsa le zhes pa nas ma 'dug cig swā hā'i bar brjod/ de nas mjug chog bya'o// nad bdag gtor ma 'di dag yi ge sngon ma rnams na nang du bya bar gsungs pa bzhin nged rang gi chog khrigs su'ang bris nas lag len de ltar byas pa yin kyang don la phyir gtang ba 'di legs shing 'gad gtsang bas slar 'di ltar bya'o// tshe drag rol drag dung byed/ mchod pa kha gsos/ bsang sbyang byin brlab/ mchod yon phal cher ma la/

bdag nyid chen mo lo ma gyon ma mchod// ces sogs sbyar/ bstod pa/ thal mo sbyar nas nad zhi ba'i 'dod gsol rnams gdangs med par bya/ sgrub zhag ji ltar byed ring sgrub khang gi rtse nas sbyang khrus byed/ grol nyin gzhi bdag gtor ma rdzogs par gtang*/ thog mar mchod phreng dang*/ rnga rol/ sku bris pa'i ba dan/ glegs bam/ gtso gtor/ sbyong chas/ khrus bum rnams mi re res gtsang sbra dang ldan pas khyer/ de'i rjes su gzungs chog byed mi dang*/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs dang*/ skye bo'i dmag mi shin du mang ba bcas byas la/ thog mar sgrub pa po rnams sgrub khang du langs nas snying po'i sngags 'ur 'don lan gcig byas pa'i mthar/ slob dpon rang nyid bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa dang*/ las kyi rdo rje 'phags pa kun dga' bo/ gzhan sgrub grogs rnams dang*/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs skye bo'i dmag dpung dang bcas pa byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang*/ phyogs skyong ba dang 'jig rten skyong ba'i rnam par gyur nas yul phyogs 'di'i nad gdon skrod cing yams zhi ba dang 'jig rten la phan gdags pa'i phyir gshegs so// zhes brjod la rol mo'i bye brag kun bsgrag cing*/ thams cad kyis pi shā tsi dang*/ sum+bha ni badz+ra satwa krodha sogs 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi sngags dang*/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya sogs bgegs skrod kyi sngags dang*/ gzhan yang phyag rdor rta mgrin sogs khro bo'i sngags shes tshad bton la grong khyer yul ljongs bskor ba'i mthar/ lho phyogs sa gtsang zhing mtho bar me long chen mo phyar la yul gyi gzugs brnyan snang ba de la las kyi rdo rje kha phyogs pas gtor ma ting lo changs bu rnams bskor nas snod gcig tu gsag dpon slob rnams kyis zhi ba dang*/ zhi drag phye ma dang*/ drag po'i sbyang ba rnams byas la bden bdar lan gsum gyi dang po rdzogs nas sbyong chas mi zhig la bskur/

chu gzhung thag shin tu ring bar skyel du gtang la rol mo drag sngags yungs kar gyis brab/ dge 'dun rnams kyis bdud zlog skye bo rnams kyis go rdeb pa dang*/ ki 'don pa sogs de ltar lan gsum byas la grong khyer so so'i steng 'og bar gsum la rdzas ril sngags can gyi dud pas bdug pa'i brda sbyar/ sdig pa sbyong ba'i til lan gsum ma yin par nyer gcig tsam gyi bar du bsreg 'di'i dmigs pa la mi'i 'gro ba kho na ma yin par sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib so so'i sna sgo nas thon/ til la thim pas til 'bru re re bzhin kaṃ yig gam sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur pa de ye shes kyi me phung shin tu che ba dang*/ thugs rje'i chu rgyun rgya mtsho ltar 'khyil pa la btab pas gtsang sing gis dag pa'i dmigs pa bsgom/ me long gi nang du gzugs brnyan shar ba la khrus rnams byas nas phar phyin drug gi khrus mjug gi sh+lo ka gsum so sor sngags dang bcas pa byas nas sku phyis/ rang gi snying ga nas zhes pa nas/ dgongs pa rtse gcig tu mdzad par gyur/ zhes dang*/ bi sa ra ta nas yams kyi nad rnams zhi bar gyur cig ces pa'i rjes su drag rol drag dung dang*/ slob dpon gyis rdor dril dang bcas pas bum chu phyogs thams cad du gtor/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs 'gre/ su mu sogs mang po 'dab nas brjod dgos rnams la mdzub mo so so la nyis bgrang dang chig bgrang byas pas grangs mi 'khrul zhing 'don bde/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag ni grub bo// zhes pa'i rjes su gzhan rnams kyis/ gang la ser sna ma gdangs dang dril gsil byed/ slob dpon gyis pi shā tsi ci rigs brjod pa'i rjes su/ bum chu yul phyogs thams cad du gtor la shān+tiṃ ku ru'i spel tshig yod pa rnams grangs ci rigs brjod/ gang la ser sna dang slob dpon gyi 'don cha rnams rdzogs nas thal mo sbyar la/

nad zhi ba'i tshigs bcad thung ngu rnams la bar gdangs dang*/ sa skya nad grol ma la rgyun gyi gdangs byas nas der gang yod la khrus chu 'gyed bkra shis kyi tshig ji ltar rigs pa brjod rjes rol mo 'bud dkrol dang bcas pas tshang ma log la/ grong khyer lcags ris bskor zhing sgo bzhi yod pa lta bu yin na lho sgo'i them pa la sgrub pa po rnams kyi rkang pa g.yas pa bzhag la 'di'i gzungs 'don/ bton tshar rjes kha rgyan la bcings pa'i gzungs kyi thum bu gcig sgo gong la btags/ de bzhin du nub byang*/ shar rnams su de ltar bya ba ni cung zhi ba dang*/ nad tshabs che na lho sgo nas shar/ byang*/ nub tu bskor/ de ltar ma yin na yul de'i gtso che ba'i rgya sgo la bya ba'am/ yang na sa yi mdung gcig tu mtshams gcod byas la gzungs sngags kyi thum bu lnga las/ bzhi yul gyi phyogs bzhir tho brtsigs pa'i nang du gzhug gcig dbus kyi rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la 'dogs pa ni gong 'og kun la 'dra bas de ltar mtshams bcad pa'i rjes su/ dge 'dun skye bo sogs rang rang gi gnas su log sgrub pa po rnams yul de'i dbus mkhar gyi rtse mo la phyin te rgyal mtshan la gzungs gdags/ mchod bstod/ 'dod gsol/ gzungs 'don/ bkra shis sogs byas nas nang du log la mjug chog dkyus bzhin byas te las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// zhes ri khrod ma'i cho ga'i zur 'debs 'di'ang sa skya pa kun blo rang nyid kyis bsgrigs pa'i lo ma gyon ma'i cho ga byin rlabs chu rgyun gyi gsal byed du bris pa 'di la gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya pa'i phyag len rnams gtso bor 'khod song bas gzhan gyis nyams su len tshe gdangs dbyangs rol mo sogs ni rang rang gi bla ma gong ma'i phyag len bzhin bgyis pas don grub bo// yi ge pa ni bsod nams 'od zer gyis bgyis pas dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig sarba dā maṅga laṃ//

༈ /ri khrod ma'i bum chog khyer bde nad yams mthar byed bzhugs so// na mo gu ru puṇ+ya rat+na paṇ+ṇa shā wa r+yai/ 'dir ri khrod ma'i bum chog mdor bsdus bya tshul ni stegs bu khebs ldan gyi dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad steng bum pa chu gtsang dang*/ bum rdzas nyer lngas bkang bar kha rgyan mgul chings/ dung chos/ dri chu/ rdor gzungs bcas bshams mthar zlum gtor gcig mtshams 'dzin chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod g.yas skor/ cha gsum gtor ma/ rdor dril/ 'thor nas/ 'og tu dgos pa'i gtor ma ting lo/ changs bu/ gu gul/ yungs kar/ me long*/ sku phyis rnams 'du byas la sgrub pa po rnams stan la 'khod nas/ mchod pa/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo dang 'phan gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shap+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab/ rol mo ji snyed pa'i sgra bya zhing*/ dharmā ra ṇi tshar gsum brjod do// de nas bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes nyer gcig sogs dang*/ de nas thal mo sbyar zhing*/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/
