zhes lan gcig sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags ma ri khrod lo ma gyon ma'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ rang skad cig gis 'phags ma ri khrod mar gsal ba'i snying ga'i nang du pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du pam̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo ri khrod lo ma can gyi dbu rgyan du bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam par bzhugs pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ thal mo sbyar la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥpaṇ+ṇa sha wa rī bh+yaḥ oṃ paṇ+ṇa sha ba rī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i sogs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs dang*/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i ri bo ljon shing sna tshogs pa'i nags tshal dang me tog sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi shes pa pam̐ yig gser gyi mdog can/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ khyad par du nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad bsal/ slar 'dus nas pam̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma ri khrod lo ma can sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa ba'i zhal ser zhing 'dzum khro'i tshul can/ g.yas zhal dkar po zhi ba'i nyams can/ g.yon zhal dmar po chags pa'i nyams can/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos thugs kar rdo rje/ gnyis pas dgra s+t+wa 'debs pa'i tshul/ gsum pas mda' gsor zhing 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang po'i sdigs mdzub la rdo rje'i zhags pa dkris pa/ gnyis pas 'bras bu dang me tog gis spud pa'i shing lo gsar pa'i sbrang g.yab/

gsum pas gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin po che dang me tog sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis spras shing*/ lha rdzas kyi na bza' dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ me tog dang 'bras bu du mas spras pa'i shing lo gsar pa gshibs pa'i smad g.yogs can/ sbrul dkar pos se ral kha byas pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du bcings shing*/ lang tsho dar la babs pa/ sku shin tu mdzes shing grims pa/ cung zad khro ba/ zhabs g.yas pa'i rting pas 'og gi phyogs bsten cing*/ pus mo gdan la btsugs pa/ g.yon pa bzhengs stabs su mdzad pa/ rnam par 'gying ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i nang du zla ba la gnas pa'i pam̐ ser po/ pam̐ las sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun ri khrod lo ma gyon ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sngar bzhin mchod nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas rang la gnyis su med par bstim mo// yang pam̐ gyi yi ge de nyid las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas de rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus kyi dri ma thams cad dag gsang sngags dang phrin las thams cad la dbang bar byas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam mo// de nas lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la sems gtad la mnyam par bzhag go

/gang gi tshe sngags bzla bar 'dod na de'i tshe/ snying ga'i nang gi pam̐ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rgyud bskul bas/ bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab cing bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang nad thams cad bsal bar gyur/ oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa sha wa rī sarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma nā ya swā hā/ zhes bya ba ni snying po'o// oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa sha wa rī hrīḥha hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya ba ni nye ba'i snying po'o// rtsa sngags ni/ tad+ya thā/ a mṛ te/ a mṛ te/ a mṛ ta ud+bha we/ a mṛ ta saṃ bha be/ ā shwa ste/ ā shwa s+t+wāṃ ge mā ma ra/ mā ma ra/ mā sa ra/ mā sa ra/ tun+na tun+na/ bi tun+na/ bi tun+na/ tu ṇa/ tu ṇa/ tu mu le swā hā/ oṃ gau rī/ gan+dha rī/ tsaṇ+ḍā li/ mā taṃ gi puk+kā si swā hā/ oṃ aṃ ku re/ maṃ ku re/ ku ra re/ par+ṇa sha ba rī swā hā/ na maḥsarba sha wa rī ṇāṃ/ ma hā sha ba rī ṇāṃ bha ga wa tī pi shā tsi par+ṇa sha wa ri pi shā tsi swā hā/ oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa sha wa rī hrīḥdza hūm̐ phaṭa pi shā tsi swā hā/ de ltar bzlas pa'i rjes su/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim/ bdag bskyed do// a mṛ tas bum pa bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyangs pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul ba bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i bum pa'i nang du pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du pam̐ yig gser gyi mdog can las 'od zer 'phros pas zhes sogs nas/

thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin la/ bdag nyid ces pa dor/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas ri khrod lo ma can la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje rnam sbyangs shing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i// khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yongs bdag 'khor dang bcas rnams gshegs su gsol// oṃ par+ṇa sha wa rī sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gros mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ dbang lha spyan 'dren sogs bdag bskyed bzhin la/ 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba zhes tshig bsgyur nas/ dbur brgyan gyi bar bdag bskyed bzhin bya/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin rlabs gong bzhin la/ oṃ par+ṇa sha wa rī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes sogs rol mo'i bar rigs 'gre sbyar/ mthar dril gsil/ dharmā ra ṇi sogs/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi// cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa las byung ba'i// lha mo gang gis sgrub po'i nad gdon bgegs// kun tu zhi mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhing dang yul rnams kun tu rnam 'phrul zhing*// khyad par ri khrod gnas su rnam rol nas// sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i// ri khrod dbang phyug ma la phyag 'tshal lo// sna tshogs zhal dang phyag zhabs sna tshogs dang*// sna tshogs mdog dang cha lugs sna tshogs dang*// sna tshogs rgyan dang phyag mtshan sna tshogs kyis// rnam par sgeg ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// khyad par gang gis 'dul ba'i thabs mkhyen nas// me tog 'bras bu du mas rnam sdud pa'i// shing lo gsar pa'i na bzas rab bklubs pa'i// lo ma gyon ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gsung gi rig sngags zhi ba'i nga ro yis// 'gro ba'i rims dang sdug bsngal zhi mdzad cing*// drag po'i gsang sngags 'brug ltar cher bsgrags pas// gdug pa 'joms mdzad gsung la phyag 'tshal lo// nyid thugs zhi
